name: shared-tooltip

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows a settled 'Bold ⌘B' tooltip with its arrow pointing at the highlighted B button.

tagline: One tooltip glides between toolbar buttons, showing each name and shortcut.
summary: A row of formatting icons where a single shared tooltip follows the pointer from button to button, sliding and reshaping to show each action's name and keyboard shortcut with an arrow.
appearance: A dark rounded toolbar holds five thin white icons: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and a link. Above the hovered icon sits a white rounded bubble with dark text and a small downward arrow; the active icon gains a faint grey square behind it.
behaviour: Hovering an icon opens the shared tooltip above it after a short delay. Moving to a neighbour makes the same bubble glide sideways, reshaping to the new text and sliding its arrow along, instead of closing and reopening.
demo_content: Five formatting buttons with tooltips: Bold ⌘B, Italic ⌘I, Underline ⌘U, Strikethrough ⌘⇧X and Insert link ⌘K.
search_phrases: keyboard shortcut cheat sheet on hover
use_when: A dense icon toolbar needs labels on hover, and separate tooltips flickering in and out would feel noisy.
avoid_when: One shared popup means only one hint shows at a time, so it suits adjacent triggers rather than distant ones.
customise: Open and close delays and the spring transition are provider props; each tooltip sets its side, offsets and alignment, and the trigger and content are yours to compose.
weight_why: One floating popup and a tiny layout animation; idle until a pointer enters.

a11y.note: Opens on focus as well as hover and links trigger to bubble with aria-describedby; the demo's icons also carry their own labels.

issues: The tooltip text is blurred for much of the glide, so the label is unreadable while it moves.
polish_why: The glide is smooth and the shortcut hint is clear; the bubble stays blurred for most of the move.
title: Shared Tooltip
